cases.about: Three strongest points with where they are (the cat aside is not one), a numbered thread, a newsletter section and three standalone posts — every number as the piece gives it.

inputs.document: Why we stopped using plastic pots

documents.title: Why we stopped using plastic pots
documents.content:
1. The trial. We grew the same plants in clay and plastic for a year.
2. Water. Plants in clay needed 20% less watering.
3. Lifespan. Plastic pots cracked after three winters.
4. Cost. Second-hand clay costs less than new plastic.
5. Aside: my cat prefers the clay ones.
